---
title: "Library"
toc: false
---

::: {.library-intro}

A collection of books I've read, am reading, and hope to read.

Browse my reading history or explore the books on my reading wishlist.

:::

```{r}
#| include: false
#| message: false
#| warning: false

library(tidyverse)
library(DT)
library(htmltools)

# --------------------------------------------------
# Import the book catalog
# --------------------------------------------------

books <- read_csv(
  "data/books.csv",
  show_col_types = FALSE
) |>
  mutate(
    date_started = as.Date(date_started),
    date_finished = as.Date(date_finished)
  )

if (!"cover_file" %in% names(books)) {
  books$cover_file <- NA_character_
}

# --------------------------------------------------
# Separate reading history and wishlist
# --------------------------------------------------

reading_books <- books |>
  filter(status != "Want to Read") |>
  mutate(
    status_order = case_when(
      status == "Reading" ~ 1L,
      status == "Finished" ~ 2L,
      TRUE ~ 3L
    ),
    sorting_date = if_else(
      status == "Finished",
      date_finished,
      date_started
    )
  ) |>
  arrange(
    status_order,
    desc(sorting_date),
    title
  )

wishlist_books <- books |>
  filter(status == "Want to Read") |>
  arrange(title)

# --------------------------------------------------
# Generate book cells with cover thumbnails
# --------------------------------------------------

make_book_cell <- function(
    title,
    page,
    cover_id,
    cover_file
) {

  # Prefer local images, then Open Library
  cover_url <- if (
    !is.na(cover_file) &&
    nzchar(cover_file)
  ) {

    cover_file

  } else if (!is.na(cover_id)) {

    paste0(
      "https://covers.openlibrary.org/b/id/",
      cover_id,
      "-M.jpg"
    )

  } else {

    NA_character_

  }

  # Generate the cover or placeholder
  cover <- if (!is.na(cover_url)) {

    tags$img(
      src = cover_url,
      alt = paste("Cover of", title),
      class = "library-cover",
      loading = "lazy"
    )

  } else {

    tags$span(
      class = "library-cover-fallback",
      "No cover"
    )

  }

  title_element <- tags$span(
    class = "library-book-title",
    title
  )

  # Link only books in the reading library
  if (!is.na(page) && nzchar(page)) {

    page_url <- str_replace(
      page,
      "\\.qmd$",
      ".html"
    )

    cell <- tags$a(
      href = page_url,
      class = "library-book-link",
      cover,
      title_element
    )

  } else {

    cell <- tags$div(
      class = "library-book-link",
      cover,
      title_element
    )

  }

  as.character(cell)
}


# --------------------------------------------------
# Generate reading-status labels
# --------------------------------------------------

make_status <- function(status) {

  status_class <- str_to_lower(status) |>
    str_replace_all("[^a-z]+", "-")

  as.character(
    tags$span(
      class = paste(
        "library-status",
        paste0("library-status--", status_class)
      ),
      status
    )
  )
}

# --------------------------------------------------
# Prepare the main Reading Library table
# --------------------------------------------------

reading_table <- reading_books |>
  mutate(
    book_display = pmap_chr(
      list(title, book_page, cover_id, cover_file),
      make_book_cell
    ),
    status_display = map_chr(
      status,
      make_status
    )
  ) |>
  transmute(
    Book = book_display,
    Author = author,
    Pages = total_pages,
    Status = status_display,
    `Date Started` = replace_na(
      as.character(date_started),
      "—"
    ),
    `Date Finished` = replace_na(
      as.character(date_finished),
      "—"
    )
  )

# --------------------------------------------------
# Prepare the Want to Read table
# --------------------------------------------------

wishlist_table <- wishlist_books |>
  mutate(
    book_display = pmap_chr(
      list(
        title,
        rep(NA_character_, n()),
        cover_id,
        cover_file
      ),
      make_book_cell
    )
  ) |>
  transmute(
    Book = book_display,
    Author = author
  )
```

## Reading Library

Books I'm currently reading, have finished, or have set aside.

::: {.library-page}

```{r}
#| echo: false

DT::datatable(
  reading_table,

  rownames = FALSE,

  escape = c(2, 3, 5, 6),

  class = "hover",

  options = list(
    pageLength = 10,
    lengthChange = FALSE,
    order = list(),
    autoWidth = FALSE,
    scrollX = TRUE,

    language = list(
      search = "Search books:",
      emptyTable = "No books recorded yet."
    )
  )
)
```

:::

## Want to Read

Books I'd like to read in the future.

::: {.library-page}

```{r}
#| echo: false

DT::datatable(
  wishlist_table,

  rownames = FALSE,

  escape = 2,

  class = "hover",

  options = list(
    pageLength = 10,
    lengthChange = FALSE,
    order = list(),
    autoWidth = FALSE,
    scrollX = TRUE,

    language = list(
      search = "Search wishlist:",
      emptyTable = "No books on the wishlist yet."
    )
  )
)
```
